items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, do you think he had any influence on singers like Benny Carter and Sy Oliver and any of the black singers? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, well, certainly, because he came along first.

ctx.x: Basie -- Basie took over Benny = wonderful guy. Moten's band, Moten's band, and Basie's the one. Yes.
